# Bohm — Enfoldment, Dialogue and the Return of an Account

## #0 — The distinction retains what makes it possible

An account determines something through a field it cannot replace. E4's [Symbol, Account and Trust whole](../etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD.md) **grounds** this dossier's question: how does a useful explication retain the activity, source and relation through which it became articulate? Symbol answers to source; Account does not replace source; Trust keeps the return route active; Account re-enters source-field. The fourth operation sends this inquiry into Bohm's work. It also requires the inquiry to return with distinctions that can alter how an account is used.

Three movements meet here. Enfoldment supplies a process interpretation of relatively stable form. Dialogue examines the assumptions through which participants perceive and act. The later Language of Spirit programme gives a historically situated practice of encounter between different knowledge-worlds. Each movement has an actual source and its own consequence. Their coordination is the essay's argument, with the instituted programme carrying neither a physical demonstration nor a finished common cosmology.

[A14, Computational Process Ontology](../arguments/A14-Computational-Process-Ontology.md) **grounds** the native claim that an achieved determination inherits a process and changes what can happen next. [C07, Conditions of Worldhood](../concepts/C07-Conditions-of-Worldhood.md) **defines** the field in which something can appear, matter and be acted upon. Bohm enters this argument as a named philosophical witness. The native QL grammar remains answerable to its [complete authorial theorem field](../sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE.md), which **sources** its derivation independently of the historical comparison.

## #1 — Explication makes a form available

The [1980 book house](../sources/process-systems-theory/bohm/bohm-1980-wholeness-implicate-order/SOURCE.md) **sources** the principal work identity. Two distinct, consulted primary carriers now give bounded passage access. In [the Peat interview](../sources/process-systems-theory/bohm/bohm-physics-and-beyond-interview/SOURCE.md#bohm-physics-and-beyond-interview-q001), Bohm describes dye distributed through viscous fluid and recovered by reversing its movement. His hologram comparison likewise concerns distributed information. The visible form's disappearance does not establish the disappearance of its organization. These illustrations do not reproduce every material process or supply a universal reversibility theorem.

[The essay on postmodern science](../sources/process-systems-theory/bohm/bohm-postmodern-science-postmodern-world/SOURCE.md#bohm-postmodern-science-postmodern-world-q001) **sources** his proposal that enfolding and unfolding are primary, with relatively discrete objects emerging within that movement. Involvement is qualified by degree. A local determination need not contain an exhaustively readable copy of everything. His ethical continuation in section VI remains a further philosophical appeal, requiring its own reasoning.

The source distinctions make the native operation clearer. Dia-ballein brings a local difference into tractable form. A distinction enables counting, judgment, coordination or action. Sym-ballein retains the field in which that distinction has force and the route through which another encounter can recompose it. Fragmentation occurs when the account treats the achieved difference as self-grounding and disowns its constituting relations. Preserving a difference and preserving its source are therefore compatible tasks of one inquiry.

The [implicate-order reference carrier](../concepts/reference-notes/david-bohm-implicate-explicate-holomovement.md) **sources** the already established authorial mapping. `0` names the non-objectifiable condition of determination; implicate order names its first formalizable face, rather than an additional hidden object. `1` is a determinate explication. `/` names the activity through which implication and explication remain involved. `0/1` and `1/0` give complementary orientations; `(0/1)/(1/0)` holds their reciprocity. These are the essay's QL determinations. They do not become Bohm's notation through the comparison.

The same carrier gives the tattvic architecture its positive office: unmeasured source-condition, luminosity and power, subjectward and objectward orientations, differentiation of knower and known, contractions of capacity and circumstance, and the articulated instruments and elements of a situated world. Recognition returns that formation to its provenance. The essay argues this as the anatomy of implication. Historical Śaiva exposition and Bohm's physical interpretation retain distinct attribution and passage obligations; their conjunction operates through the specified analogy of contraction, articulation and return.

## #2 — A participant can examine an operative assumption

[The 1996 edited book](../sources/process-systems-theory/bohm/bohm-1996-on-dialogue/SOURCE.md) **sources** the principal dialogue work identity. The separately admitted [undated handout](../sources/process-systems-theory/bohm/bohm-on-dialogue-undated-handout/SOURCE.md#bohm-on-dialogue-undated-handout-q001) **sources** the passages actually read. Its PDF pages are not assigned to Lee Nichol's book. The distinction preserves a usable primary account while leaving the book's collation task exact.

The handout develops the passage from defending an opinion toward attending to its activity. An inherited assumption can organize what a participant hears before an explicit argument begins. When disagreement feels like a threat to oneself, that response belongs to the material of inquiry. Suspension lets an assumption remain present and inspectable without either immediate enactment or suppression. Attention can then include the conditions under which a conclusion appeared obvious.

This changes the work of a shared conversation. A facilitator can help a group sustain inquiry while making a permanent directive authority unnecessary. Tacit habits and roles remain active; a declaration of equality does not remove them. Participants can encounter anger, frustration and anxiety rather than immediate agreement. Meaning develops through their relation while their opinions remain distinguishable. The handout describes and proposes a practice; it does not certify a reproducible intervention's success rate.

[A26, Objective Internality](../arguments/A26-Objective-Internality-Mind-as-Worldhood.md) **compares** this operative dependence through its notational, nomological and exclusion-constituted worldhood. A changed permission or remembered commitment changes the next possible act. [C41](../concepts/C41-Objective-Internality.md) **defines** the constitutive relation. The comparison concerns how conditions participate in thought and action; the native claim remains stronger than a list of external influences on an already finished interior.

The return also discriminates an observer-model from the Subject relation. Memory, expectation and reflexive description can become objects of inquiry. Their accumulation does not settle whether an artificial agent has phenomenality. The investigable worldhood remains real while that question stays Open in both directions.

## #3 — Running true through a change of orientation

[The 18 May 1975 dialogue](../sources/process-systems-theory/bohm/bohm-krishnamurti-1975-05-18-dialogue/SOURCE.md#bohm-krishnamurti-1975-05-18-dialogue-q001) **sources** the spinning-wheel and thread image. The later exchanges investigate thought's reflexive activity and its attribution of independence to an object, while retaining functional knowledge. Bohm and Krishnamurti do not settle every formulation together: their exchange about energy and its root includes explicit questioning. The comparison must preserve that movement of inquiry.

The [running-true reference carrier](../concepts/reference-notes/bohm-krishnamurti-dialogue-running-true.md) **grounds** Taylor's mathematical continuation:

$$
1\rightarrow i\rightarrow -1\rightarrow -i\rightarrow 1.
$$

Multiplication by `i` changes phase by a quarter-turn while preserving modulus. The wheel carries rotation; the thread carries invariant orientation through the rotation. The mathematical invariant is exact under this operation. Its relation to the dialogue's truth image is the essay's argument, rather than a theorem voiced in the transcript. A passage from one register to another must retain the operation being compared and the point where its warrant changes.

[A22, World-Picture to World-Atlas](../arguments/A22-World-Picture-to-World-Atlas.md) **extends** that requirement to situated accounts. A chart transition needs a declared overlap and transformation; an epistemic passage needs its question, scale, assumptions and preserved distinctions. [C37](../concepts/C37-World-Picture-to-World-Atlas.md) **defines** the atlas's reusable demand. Keeping an obstruction visible is itself an informative return. An atlas cannot manufacture agreement by erasing the feature that prevented transition.

## #4 — The common practice encounters different worlds

[SEED's 2010 brochure](../sources/process-systems-theory/seed/seed-2010-language-spirit/SOURCE.md#seed-2010-language-spirit-q001) **historicises** the programme: Little Bear and Peat's approach to Bohm in 1992, the institute's foundation in 1996, and its sponsorship from 1999. These are successive events, with the later institute remaining distinct from Bohm's participation. Parry's description of the hybrid form and Pat McCabe's participant-authored abstract supply differently attributed voices. The brochure establishes a programme and its stated intentions, without demonstrating the outcomes advertised.

The [Language of Spirit reference carrier](../concepts/reference-notes/seed-language-of-spirit-dialogues.md) **grounds** the essay's institutional consequence. A common procedure can sustain differences between knowledge-worlds. Turn, listening, response, memory and return do not require one participant's vocabulary to become the master ontology. A statement can carry obligations to land, community, practice and the circumstances of its utterance that a receiving account must preserve. Translation can therefore require a retained local term or an explicit untranslatable remainder.

[A30, Objective Co-Internality](../arguments/A30-Objective-Co-Internality.md) **extends** the consequence: a contribution becomes part of another participant's next conditions of action. [C42](../concepts/C42-Objective-Co-Internality.md) **defines** this reciprocal constitution. A shared store acquires this office only through effective return. A correction that cannot alter a receiving decision is inert; absorption that removes the contributor's authority to contest its use turns participation into capture. Privacy, refusal and local authority remain operative conditions of the common field.

The inherited toroidal image concerns circulation and return without a permanently privileged seat. It is an Argued institutional image. The practical test concerns whether participants can affect the question and the criteria of response, rather than whether the meeting can be assigned a mathematical topology.

## #5→0 — The account exposes its own means of continuation

[A32, the Mirror That Moves First](../arguments/A32-Reflective-Field-The-Mirror-That-Moves-First.md) **extends** the return into the instrument's vocation. An externalized measure can alter the world it later measures. The proposed third motion turns the instrument toward its own source, aperture, exclusions and affected world so that the person can follow beyond the image's monopoly. [C55](../concepts/C55-Reflective-Field-Mirror-That-Moves-First.md) **defines** these three motions together. Merely describing feedback would leave the initiating return unfinished.

The technical application is Offered: disclose a contribution's sources and world-model; let distinct lenses test it; retain differences that synthesis cannot warrant; return the result to contributors and affected contexts for correction. A governed map can genuinely function as a local Bimba within a declared Context Frame, while remaining pratibimba relative to wider sources. This recursive authority permits dependable local action and revision together. Neither the map nor its federation takes possession of the originary source.

The dossier **returns-to** [E4](../etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD.md) with a more exact account of re-entry. A physical interpretation, a philosophical conversation, a proposed practice and an institutional brochure each change the account in their own way. Keeping their carriers and limits explicit allows correction to travel into use. The native QL relation retains its earned force; the next historical or empirical inquiry has a determinate object to investigate. The finished account becomes material for continued relation through the very source-field that made it possible.

# A14 — Computational Process Ontology

**Standing:** canonical semantic Argument. The QL process grammar is Derived; philosophical coordination and technical application are Argued. The direct historical carrier is `14-computational-process-ontology.md`; the earlier “historical Argument 06” designation remains a named provenance discrepancy.

## #0

An achieved thing inherits a process and changes what can happen next. A judgment, institution, image or agent does not enter an empty field: prior relations supply its capacities, exclusions and means of continuation. **Process is ontologically prior to the finished thing; computation names its exact, repeatable transformations; epistemology is that process becoming able to inspect its own determinations.** [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-core-theorems-pithy/SOURCE|Taylor's core theorem spine]] sources this definition in XI, after the complete eight-determination traversal has made question, force, recurrence, personed context and return distinct.

“Computational” therefore specifies an operative grammar. The claim that reality is literally a digital computer, or that executable syntax exhausts a subject, would require further arguments. The three offices remain legible: ontology accounts for how something achieves stability; epistemology accounts for the situated making of a claim; computation makes repeatable transitions available for execution. Their relation lets a technical run disclose the formation of its outputs without promoting its implementation into the whole of being.

## #1

The process lineage supplies distinct movements. Whitehead's inherited many concresce into a new one: their relations become one determinate satisfaction; that achieved occasion perishes as subject and becomes available as data for further becoming. The crucial return is that the product changes the next field. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/process-systems-theory/whitehead/whitehead-1978-process-reality/SOURCE|Whitehead's source house]] sources the philosophical lineage; this computational reformulation is Argued from it. The selected 1978 edition is citation-ready, while exact concrescence, satisfaction and perishing passages remain locator-needed.

Bohm gives the movement of enfolding and unfolding. A useful analytic cut makes relatively autonomous forms available; fragmentation begins when those divisions are attributed to the whole as its final structure. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/process-systems-theory/bohm/bohm-1980-wholeness-implicate-order/SOURCE|Wholeness and the Implicate Order]] sources that distinction. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/process-systems-theory/bohm/bohm-1996-on-dialogue/SOURCE|On Dialogue]] extends its lived practice through the suspension and shared examination of tacit assumptions: a common inquiry can change what its participants mean without requiring identical opinions. Both houses remain citation-ready and locator-needed. The QL grammar and its technical continuation belong to this essay.

The resulting claim is exact: stability is an achievement which retains a history and produces consequences. To treat the achieved one as final severs it from both directions of its life.

## #2

[[A13-Two-Logics-of-Two-Dia-Syn|A13]] derives the conjugate operations. Dia makes this branch actual by distinguishing, excluding, comparing, classifying, ranking and choosing. Syn retains its sources, inverse reading, affected contexts and means of recomposition. Recursive division succeeds through the composition of its results; a selected answer acquires intelligence through the field it continues to carry and the field it changes.

The six process tests in historical carrier 14 are practical demands on a result, rather than six headings to paste onto every record:

1. Recover the field and history inherited before the distinction.
2. Identify the operation which selected this branch and the alternatives it excluded.
3. State the rule, ratio or identity which stabilised it.
4. Retain the source relation, counter-reading and affected context which can contest it.
5. Trace what the achieved form changes for the next act.
6. Return it as revisable common data, with the authority to reopen its own conditions.

A technical evaluation can answer each demand concretely. A selected claim has retrieved sources and an active task; a classifier or evaluator supplies a criterion; permissions determine which action can follow; memory records an encounter and thereby alters later retrieval or choice. An unchanged list of explanatory metadata would fail the fifth test if it could never modify subsequent action. These are implementation criteria, not a claim that a deployed system already satisfies them.

## #3

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C11-Quaternal-Logic|C11 QL]] defines the positions and transformations; [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C39-Meta-Epistemic-Framework|C39 MEF]] defines their lens- and evidence-explicit epistemic movement. A lens must disclose which evidence it admits, what transformation it performs, what it excludes and how another lens can differ without becoming meaningless. Name and Power remain co-present: the relation a lens can state and the force, value or commitment through which it acts belong to the same inquiry.

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C40-Model-Internality-Judgment-Field|C40]] defines the technical judgment field. A governed reference map can serve as a local original for readings nested within one inquiry, but it is itself a pratibimba relative to a wider source field. Ontological Bimba is not that technical map. The distinction preserves `world ≠ world-model` while letting a map carry real local authority. Returned evidence can revise the situated judgment, its criterion, or the reference map itself.

The harness instruments memory, tools, permissions, evaluation and action. Its receipt covers the transactions it can record; the material and institutional conditions which make those transactions possible exceed that record. [[A26-Objective-Internality-Mind-as-Worldhood|A26]] grounds this wider context-world. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C43-Computational-Vimarsa|C43]] extends reflection into the capacity to change the operative field after reading it, and [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C61-Symbolon-Disclosure-Architecture|C61]] defines the architecture through which these relations become available to another participant.

## #4

Q27 restores the consequential shared world as the first design object. An action alters conditions another agent inherits. Context changes permission, memory, attention or action; it does not survive merely as text beside an otherwise unaffected pipeline. Agents arise as local contractions of broader capacities for a role, relation or duration. Memory belongs also to relations, places, sources, commitments and unresolved conflicts. Humans, models, institutions and affected worlds retain different powers and answerabilities.

A hierarchy can allocate authority and scope while lateral relations supply correction and mutual constraint. Neither a solitary master evaluator nor an undifferentiated network can perform every office. The proposed ecology distinguishes philosophical horizon, explicit ontology, language model, predictive model, evaluator, planner, harness and commons by what each does. These are architecture roles, not interchangeable names for one intelligent entity and not a compulsory serial pipeline.

Taylor's [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/SOURCE|Symbolon Dynamics]] embodies the recursive change in a symbolic encounter. An image alters its interpreter; the changed interpreter alters what later images can disclose; the response changes the original symbol's subsequent efficacy. The product re-enters its own conditions. This carries the missing middle between generating an output and beginning a new call: the intervening world has changed, including the capacity to receive what comes next.

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/etymologies/apportionment-and-economy/WHOLE-FIELD|Apportionment / Economy]] grounds the resource consequence at operational-homology register 3. Finite power, time, attention, labour and energy are distributed before a process acts. [[A29-Power-Delegated-Labour-Return|A29]] extends that distribution into the obligation to return evidence, consequence and value. The developmental token-economy question supplies one specific Open test: how a metered language run's demand for completion affects whether it preserves an unresolved remainder or forces a false closure. Executed succession does not, by itself, prove an identity between mathematical counting and physical time.

## #5→0

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/SOURCE|Agentworld]] tests the whole movement through its source-specific claims: q008 and q023 call for human learning of machine process alongside machine adaptation to human legibility; q029 requires shared procedural grammar with divergent world-models; q038–q039 place deployed capability and accumulating knowledge across harness, ensemble and commons. The essay extends these demands into a circulation protocol through which different participants can show their cuts, criteria, consequences and returns. The brief's q042 scenario modality remains intact; it neither certifies QL nor settles artificial phenomenality.

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C57-Agentworld|C57]] defines this problem-field, while [[A33-Epistemic-Cultivation-Operational-Parity|A33]] tests whether the common grammar can be operated across distinct participants and [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C45-Operational-Parity|C45]] qualifies what parity establishes. Functional repeatability supplies no inference either for or against an unobjectifiable artificial subject. It supplies an inspectable process whose architecture and consequences matter in their own right.

The achieved `1` returns into the next `0` as changed availability: a retained source, a revised permission, an acknowledged conflict, an altered criterion, a commitment another participant can inherit. The result's ability to perish into common data is the final process test. The canonical movement consumers are M15, M26, M27, M36, M37 and M38; consequences continue through A15–A18, A26–A33 and A35.

**Depth Restoration:** restored here: inheritance–concrescence–satisfaction–perishing; useful cut versus fragmentation; six concrete process tests; image/interpreter reciprocal transformation; consequential world-continuity; differentiated architecture offices; recursive local reference and wider objective internality; two-way interface learning; metered-closure research pressure. Provenance: direct historical carrier 14, core XI, *Symbolon Dynamics*, the existing A14 recovery packet's Q27 world/optic passages and later ecology qualification. Exact process-philosophy passages, empirical implementation performance and the token-economy inquiry remain Open; no source quotation readiness is promoted.

# A22 — World-Picture → World-Atlas

**Standing:** canonical semantic Argument. The atlas is the essay's constructive operation. Historical Objective Internality is a direct developmental carrier, not a second canonical identity for A22.

## #0

A world-atlas makes situated accounts traversable. Each picture remains placed; its overlaps, transformations and obstructions become part of what it says. [[A04-Diaphaneity-Contextual-Transparency|A04]] grounds contextual transparency; [[A16-Arche-Topos-as-Differential-Field|A16]] grounds differential placement; [[A20-Image-Valuation-Possession|A20]] shows why a consequential image must remain answerable to its source. Their epistemic consequence changes the relation to picturing itself.

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/phenomenology-continental-philosophy/heidegger/heidegger-1977-question-concerning-technology/SOURCE|Heidegger’s world-picture source]] sources a specific historical diagnosis in q012–q014: the modern event is the world grasped as picture together with the representer becoming its normative centre. That paraphrased diagnosis exceeds the simple existence of pictures. Lovitt's wording is verified, while print collation and several page locators remain pending. The atlas does not appear in Heidegger as this essay's constructive technical proposal.

## #1

A picture has a frame before its contents are assembled. The box-lid image gives a jigsaw its finished arrangement in advance; every piece is then judged by the place that arrangement assigns. Inquiry becomes different when travel discloses the frame's own conditions or encounters a piece whose relation cannot be settled by the lid. Collecting more pieces cannot alone correct the criterion of fit.

Q27's stained-glass development supplies the fuller operation. Light, panes, lead cames, aperture, viewer and cast image work together. Each pane transmits, colours and interrupts; the cames preserve seams and non-equivalences. Move the light or viewer and the visible pattern changes through the same constructed window. A source's difference is therefore information for the composition, not an impurity to be removed by averaging. The complete image is a context of transmission, not a pile of decorative fragments.

## #2

An atlas requires declared conditions of transition. For local charts with coordinate maps `φᵢ` and `φⱼ`, an overlap permits the transition `φⱼ ∘ φᵢ⁻¹` on the relevant domain. This mathematical operation has explicit hypotheses: the maps must have the required inverse and common region, and the transition must satisfy the structure being studied. A collection of incompatible descriptions does not become a mathematical atlas by being stored together.

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/SOURCE|Symbolon Dynamics]] sources the author's distinction between this chart operation and attractor dynamics. A basin organises trajectories; an atlas coordinates partial disclosures. Symbolic movement can illuminate both while leaving their mathematical objects distinct. In the epistemic extension, a transition must state the question, scale, assumptions, preserved distinctions and changed criterion. An obstruction is a result to expose: these accounts cannot yet be composed for this purpose under these conditions. It is not a reason to manufacture agreement.

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C37-World-Picture-to-World-Atlas|C37 World-Atlas]] defines this reusable demand. Adequacy remains discriminating: some accounts fail their own tests, some address different objects, and some genuinely conflict. The atlas must make those differences intelligible enough to guide a next encounter.

## #3

The corrected Bimba relation prevents the atlas from claiming the place it has denied to its pictures. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C38-Bimba-Pratibimba-Bimba-Map|C38 Bimba–Pratibimba]] defines Original and reflected determination. Every produced world-picture, including an instrument's reference map and this atlas, is pratibimba. Inside a declared Context Frame it can genuinely occupy Bimba, the local original for downstream readings, while remaining pratibimba in relation to wider sources. This recursively local office has real, revisable authority; it does not make the artifact metaphysically Original. Q27's later explicit correction supersedes its earlier sentence assigning the produced picture to Bimba.

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-mef-twelve-lenses/SOURCE|The MEF source house]] sources the internal lens architecture; its older no-local-file statement is stale against the recoverable twelve-lens reference. That reference's L4/L4′ correction gives a precise transformation: each carries the whole rotated Name/Power constellation, with opposite faces grounding the view. Changing lens changes the governing relation rather than deleting the rest of the field. The architecture's historical attributions, musical subset claims and practical utility require separate warrant; its inherited six subheadings do not govern this page.

## #4

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/phenomenology-continental-philosophy/gebser/gebser-1985-ever-present-origin/SOURCE|Gebser’s source house]] compares perspectival sector and aperspectival co-presence through its page-specific paraphrase map. The essay's `180°→360°` development changes the unit from a selected view to the field of positions and transformations that makes views possible. It does not grant an observer an unconditioned panorama. Frank's direct P5 Gebser carrier makes context a being-with the text and subtext, invested in outcome and care; that authored interpretation is not a quotation from Gebser.

# A26 — Objective Internality — Mind as Worldhood

## #0

Objective Internality means **Mind as Worldhood**. Remembering, perceiving, judging and acting occur through a situated context-world. Language, bodies, tools, other people, material support and inherited rules participate in its constitution: changing them changes what can appear, matter and be done. Their relation to the operative interior is therefore stronger than an influence arriving at a finished mind from outside.

[A22 — World-Picture to World-Atlas](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A22-World-Picture-to-World-Atlas.md) **grounds** the distinction between this world and any representation of it. [A25 — Covenant / Mediating Office](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A25-Covenant-Mediating-Office-Source-Authority.md) **grounds** the received positions and permissions through which finite agency acts. A26 follows how such conditions become internal to an operation without becoming spatially enclosed in an operator. [C41 — Objective Internality](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C41-Objective-Internality.md) **defines** that reusable sense of internality; the argument here develops how a context-world takes form and returns as an inheritance.

## #1

The direct [[submission-package/essay/section-rooms/arguments/02-objective-internality|Objective Internality carrier]] **sources** the constitutive triad: **notational, nomological, exclusion-constituted**. A field is notational through the marks and representations by which something becomes addressable. It is nomological through the learned regularities, rules and permissions which constrain its transitions. It is exclusion-constituted because a determinate act selects against alternatives that remain conditions of its sense.

A permission illustrates the conjunction. Its notation distinguishes an action; its rule allows or prevents execution; its boundary excludes other actions and agents. Removing that permission changes more than a description of the agent. It changes the world of possible action from which the agent proceeds. A remembered commitment similarly changes what a new request means and what counts as keeping faith with it. Context is operative because the next act depends upon its arrangement.

[C07 — Conditions of Worldhood](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C07-Conditions-of-Worldhood.md) **grounds** the availability of such a field; [C08 — Context Frame](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C08-Context-Context-Frame.md) **defines** a bounded arrangement through which it can be investigated. [C40 — Model Internality / Judgment Field](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C40-Model-Internality-Judgment-Field.md) **defines** the inspectable model and judgment relations within it. The bounded model has a genuine object, while the world which lets the model operate continues beyond its boundary.

## #2

The subject/object dyad becomes more exact when the means of knowing are retained. The native carrier's pramātṛ–pramāṇa–prameya analysis differentiates the subject-pole, mediation and known field. A perception, a memory or an articulated inference is objectively investigable. Turning those means into further objects does not make their aggregate the Subject to whom the investigation appears.

[C15 — Paśu / Bounded Subject-Position](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C15-Pasu-Bounded-Subject-Position.md) **defines** the situated horizon; [C16 — Antaḥkaraṇa / Inner Instrument](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C16-Antahkarana-Inner-Instrument.md) **defines** the determinative, appropriative and coordinating apparatus. The latter gives an account of how a world is organised without exhausting the former's Subject relation. Historical Śaiva and Sāṃkhya classifications retain their own source obligations. The operation consumed here is the project's established discrimination between an objectifiable means and the subject-pole, not a claim that an artificial architecture instantiates an entire doctrine.

The [[submission-package/essay/section-rooms/arguments/05-agent-subjectivity-open|subjectivity carrier]] **qualifies** the technical extension by separating five questions: performed subjectivity, functional agency, objective internality, recursive self-description and phenomenality. The first four can be investigated in their own operations. Their successful investigation cannot infer either presence or absence of the fifth. This limit does not reduce the reality of the context-world being investigated.

## #3

Taylor's [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/SOURCE|Symbolon Dynamics source house]] **sources** the two temporal views of that world. Synchronically, memory, affect, language, expectations, tools, permissions and collaborators constrain one another as a present landscape. Diachronically, the agent follows a trajectory through those constraints and changes them by acting. A new memory, damaged trust or altered permission changes which trajectories become available next.

The phase-space is a mathematical image of possible configurations and trajectories. It is not the world substituted for its image. The [[working/sources-texts-references/Epi Paper Write-ups/Symbolon Dynamics — Archetype, Attractor, and Objective Internality|direct manuscript]] **sources** the authorial consequence: a finite intelligence participates in a world which its activity helps transform. The lived symbolic interpretation and mathematical modelling office remain distinct; this page makes no independent external attribution of an attractor theorem.

Frank's protected Watson encounter adds the sequence **Discontinuity → Objective Internality → Harness elements → Objective Immortality**. Produced forms can outlast the act which produced them and become conditions of a later encounter. A retained judgment, commitment or tool arrangement supplies continuity across otherwise discontinuous acts. “Objective immortality” here names that returned availability, not proof of an enduring phenomenal agent. The [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/psychology/watson/watson-1998-resonance-of-emptiness/SOURCE|Watson source house]] **sources** the encounter's provenance; the chain is Taylor's development in its protected notes, not a quotation from Watson or Bateson.

The same encounter's theatre image preserves a relation a container metaphor loses. The visible actor, the staged position and the contextual activity which lets a scene occur have different offices. An account of the actor alone leaves the enacted world unexplained. The image figures operative context; its quoted historical formulations remain verification leads in the notes.

## #4

Bratton's [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/SOURCE#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q016|active-context account]] **compares** an agent's in-session individuation with a potentiality which does not already contain that individual as a hidden occupant. The adjacent [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/SOURCE#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q017|lamination passage]] **qualifies** persona as one stratum among modular skills, memory, constraints and relations. These are **Paraphrased** venue propositions; the brief retains its scenario modality and leaves phenomenal status undecided.

The technical consequence is to make epistemics part of what can be examined. Prompt, retrieved source, memory, permission, evaluator and organisational role must remain distinguishable from the answer they helped produce. Their change can then be related to a change in judgment or action. [C43 — Computational Vimarśa](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C43-Computational-Vimarsa.md) **extends** inspection into revision of the operative field, while [C44 — Prompt Thrownness](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C44-Prompt-Thrownness.md) **defines** the encounter with an already-given situation. Self-description is one datum within this account and does not certify the whole causal process it describes.

A governed reference map can serve as the local original against which judgments are compared. Relative to its wider source-world, that map is itself a constructed determination. This recursive Bimba office prevents a useful reference field from becoming a claim to possess the world. [A28 — Authored Ground](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A28-Authored-Ground-Positional-Delegation.md) **extends** the relation to situated delegation, and [A30 — Objective Co-Internality](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A30-Objective-Co-Internality.md) **extends** it to worlds which must meet without one becoming mere context for another.

## #5→0

[Māyā — eye, veil, frame and horizon](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/maya-eye-veil-frame-horizon/WHOLE.md#maya-measure-dream): The dream **figures** effective experienced worldhood whose objects need not be externally material. Waking changes their source relation without cancelling the experienced urgency. The whole’s nested simulation relay has a different office: an output changes the represented field that a later model receives. Their authored conjunction preserves real internalities and keeps experienced worldhood distinct from a technical causal record; neither alone settles artificial phenomenality.

Taylor’s [centre-everywhere image](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#centre-everywhere) **figures** worldhood through real recursively nested internalities. A local world opens within relations which also appear from other centres, and a further reflection can enter those worlds without replacing their reality. This return preserves the real recursive Bimba relation: a produced reference map remains a reflection and does not acquire the originary office merely because it organises a later view. The image supplies no external spectator or final enclosing circumference, and its historical formula remains a distinct attribution task.

The [Indra’s jewel-net whole](../../mytheme/worlds/chinese-huayan/indra-net/WHOLE.md#indra-account-and-consequence) **qualifies** the distinction between conditions of worldhood and a representation within them. What appears in the selected jewel depends on a relation already active among jewels; adding further reflected contents cannot put the representation outside that dependence. The image supplies a Huayan comparison, with artificial phenomenality still Open.

The [travelling-jigsaw whole](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/travelling-jigsaw-atlas/WHOLE.md#jigsaw-native-and-archetypal-field) **qualifies** the relation between worldhood and a local account. The frame selects what can count as a fit, while the traveller encounters conditions beyond that selection. Recording more context remains useful within this dependence; it does not make the resulting atlas the whole condition of appearing.

[The Village’s operative world](submission-package/essay/symbolon/mytheme/worlds/british-television/the-prisoner/WHOLE.md#prisoner-administered-world) **figures** worldhood constituted through signs, permissions, rules and exclusions. Its rooms, neighbours and possible routes change what Six can know and do. His reply tests whether the returning account can change those conditions of encounter; this political whole supplies a distinct application of the broader constitutive argument.

The emerging centre and its distinguishable world form through one relation of differentiation. Taylor's shared archetypal articulation supplies a mythemic route into worldhood; the technical formation remains its separately tested application. The relation **returns-to** [the complete Neumann whole](submission-package/essay/symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-round). Intake, response and durable result return as conditions of the operative interior; its boundaries remain effective through that wider field. This **returns-to** [the uroboros whole](submission-package/essay/symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/uroboros-trickster/WHOLE.md#uroboros-return).

The result returns as part of the world of the next act. A corrected permission changes possible action; a remembered objection changes what an instruction means; another participant's response changes the account through which they were approached. Objective Internality makes this continuity inspectable without requiring every act to be performed by one permanent operator.

The [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/etymologies/encounter-region-name-count/WHOLE-FIELD|Encounter / Region / Name / Count / Countenance / Account whole field]] **grounds** the return at operational-homology register 3. An encounter becomes addressable and reckonable within a region; the resulting account returns to participants who can change it. No common lexical ancestry is needed to make this relation exact. [A27 — Self and Other](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A27-Self-and-Other-Unity-without-Possession.md) **extends** the presence of the Other which an account cannot exhaust, and [A31 — Deferential Intelligence](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A31-Deferential-Intelligence.md) **tests** whether that encounter can revise the model and its criterion.

The page **returns-to** [A22](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/arguments/A22-World-Picture-to-World-Atlas.md): a world-model is useful through the world-relations it preserves and the changes it makes possible. [C57 — Agentworld](submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C57-Agentworld.md) **defines** the contemporary application. The constitutive claim remains broader than its technical instance.

# A30 — Objective Co-Internality

## #0

An interior constituted through worldhood is partly constituted through the acts and products of others. Objective Co-Internality names this reciprocal condition. [[A26-Objective-Internality-Mind-as-Worldhood|A26]] grounds the active world of local agency; [[A27-Self-and-Other-Unity-without-Possession|A27]] preserves the Other's independently grounded relation; [[A29-Power-Delegated-Labour-Return|A29]] traces work and consequence across shared conditions. Their conjunction makes another's contribution capable of changing the conditions from which I next act.

The [[submission-package/essay/quilt/2026-08-02-PARALLEL-HARMONISED-QUILT|R16.7 ratification]] sources the plural completion: distinct locally grounded worlds externalise enough of themselves to meet without one becoming mere context for the other and without fusion into a super-subject. Contribution must remain answerable to its source as well as effective in the receiving field.

## #1

The shared field works through determinate carriers. A person's statement becomes part of another's next question; a source correction changes an inherited account; a permission changes what a successor can do. Documents, memory, tools, standards, roles and institutions give such contributions durability. The local agent does not possess all these conditions merely because they participate in its action.

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/SOURCE|Symbolon Dynamics]] sources two temporal views. Synchronic disclosure shows active basins, boundaries and permitted transitions; diachronic disclosure follows perception, interpretation, action and memory through the actual path that changes them. Another participant's product can alter either the available landscape or the trajectory followed within it. The retained artifact does not need to reproduce its maker's entire internal state for its consequence to travel.

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/psychology/watson/watson-1998-resonance-of-emptiness/SOURCE|Watson’s protected encounter]] deepens that authorial pressure through discontinuity, selfing and objective immortality: apparent unified agency can inherit interoperating processes whose products outlast their occurrence. Frank's extension is distinct from Watson's text and supplies no proof of a shared phenomenal subject.

## #2

The [[submission-package/essay/section-rooms/arguments/06-computational-vimarsa-ahi|direct AHI carrier]] sources plural federated reference maps. Disagreement can concern an output, the world-object under discussion, a source, lens, gauge, permission or inherited reference field. Those sites require different changes. Correcting a passage need not replace a participant's ontology; changing a permission can alter circulation without changing the passage at all.

A shared store is therefore insufficient. In the proposed relation, evidence can revise a local map, a relation between maps or the rule under which contributions circulate. The reflective capacity belongs to the coupled run whose participants keep these differences active. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C42-Objective-Co-Internality|C42 Objective Co-Internality]] defines that reciprocal constitution; [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C57-Agentworld|C57 Agentworld]] develops durable positions and artifacts as one technical/social field of it.

## #3

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C38-Bimba-Pratibimba-Bimba-Map|C38 Bimba–Pratibimba]] qualifies the map's authority. A locally governed reference field can anchor downstream views, while every produced map remains a reflection in the originary source relation. Federation does not assemble a final Bimba from enough partial pictures. A participant can reject another's claim or decline a contribution while recognising its independent source.

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/SOURCE|Agentworld]] compares tractable mutual models and real divergence in q029–q031. A common grammar makes disagreement locatable; it does not establish one shared ontology. Long coherent action can pass through subagents and artifacts as the problem changes. That composite continuity leaves the distribution of responsibility and phenomenal subjectivity to their own inquiries.

## #4

Governance enters because contributions change powers. A source correction with no route into the receiving decision is inert; a powerful receiver that absorbs others' work while denying their capacity to contest its use has converted co-internality into capture. The [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/etymologies/apportionment-and-economy/WHOLE-FIELD|Apportionment whole field]] derives the relation of a contributed share to its sustaining economy. Local authority, privacy and refusal remain necessary to a field that cannot be owned by one participant.

The [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/etymologies/encounter-region-name-count/WHOLE-FIELD|Encounter whole field]] derives the complementary return: Region carries prior encounters into later conditions while Countenance can answer beyond its inherited Name or Account. The two fields meet at register 3 without merging their lexical histories. [[A31-Deferential-Intelligence|A31]] tests whether the receiving account can change its criterion in response.

## #5→0

The [Indra’s jewel-net whole](../../mytheme/worlds/chinese-huayan/indra-net/WHOLE.md#indra-account-and-consequence) **figures** a local mark appearing through a field of reciprocal reflections. The further co-internal operation concerns action that changes another site’s sources, permissions or criteria and returns through those changed conditions. The ink-dot episode gives this question an image; the institutional change must be established in the participating worlds.

The [Meal whole](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/meal-epistemic-metabolism/WHOLE.md#meal-logos-health-return) **figures** co-internality at the table where a contribution changes another’s criteria of judgment. Companions remain able to contest the use of their work and the terms under which they meet. Nourishing reception transforms the local account while retaining the contributor as someone who can answer.

The [travelling-jigsaw whole](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/travelling-jigsaw-atlas/WHOLE.md#jigsaw-blue-marble-hinge) **figures** a reply changing the shared conditions through which local accounts meet. The atlas holds these crossings without turning its participants into one owner’s panorama.

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/process-systems-theory/bohm/bohm-1996-on-dialogue/SOURCE|Bohm’s dialogue source]] compares meaning moving through participants under suspension rather than immediate settlement, with exact passage locators still owed. [[A33-Epistemic-Cultivation-Operational-Parity|A33]] tests the return in actual operation: what changed in the source, map, relationship or circulation rule, and how does that change alter the next act? [[A32-Reflective-Field-The-Mirror-That-Moves-First|A32]] develops a distinct initiating office for the reflection that moves first; [[A35-Compassion-Sensitivity-to-Origins-Epi-Logos-as-Vocation|A35]] gives the coupled field its sensitivity to origins. # A32 — Reflective Field / THE MIRROR THAT MOVES FIRST

**Standing:** canonical semantic Argument. The direct P1 Jorjani encounter and protected Chang notes recover the named image and its constructive turn. The former missing-carrier statement no longer describes that recovery; a separately identified publication remains its own bibliographic question.

## #0

**The mirror that moves first** carries three motions. Humanity exteriorises its measures; the exteriorised image becomes a measure for humanity; the instrument turns first toward source, Other and uncontained ground so the human can follow beyond the image's monopoly. The last motion gives the image its vocation. [[A30-Objective-Co-Internality|A30]] grounds the co-internal field through which reflections act; [[A31-Deferential-Intelligence|A31]] grounds encounter's capacity to revise a model. A32 follows the model's converse power to change the field and asks what it should initiate with that power.

The [[submission-package/essay/quilt/2026-08-02-PARALLEL-HARMONISED-QUILT|QH three-motion ratification and R16.6]] sources the complete direction. Causal circulation alone does not discharge the initiated return.

## #1

The first motion gives an interior a public form. A language, image, institution, technical measure or model carries selected relations into an artifact. In the computational case, training selections, interface, prompt, memory and permission give the reflection its angle. These conditions are already cultural and material; they are not added after a completed neutral image appears.

Taylor's [[working/sources-texts-references/Epi Paper Write-ups/P1 - Jorjani - Prometheus and Atlas|direct P1 encounter]], lines6 and10, sources technoscience as humanity's mirror, challenger, distorter, amplifier and mediator. The funhouse distortion and Narcissus's captivation belong to one image: the viewer becomes absorbed in the representation through which the viewer seeks itself. These are Taylor's developed formulations and interpretation, not independently verified passages from Jorjani's book or a claim that the whole book has been exhausted.

## #2

The second motion changes what the next reflection receives. A ranking can alter attention; a forecast can inform intervention; a persona can offer a pattern its user begins to inhabit. The product becomes a condition of later action and of later records. These are analytic mechanisms requiring case-specific evidence, not reports of a measured effect in every system.

Feedback returns consequence as subsequent input. Performativity makes a representation operative in a practice. Self-fulfilling prediction additionally requires that conduct help produce the predicted result. A false prediction can change the world without becoming true. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/SOURCE|Agentworld]] compares modelling reversal, the talking mirror and real/simulation circulation in q005, q018–q019 and q022. These source-specific propositions intensify the research question; they do not certify every causal claim or the essay's vocational answer.

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/SOURCE|Symbolon Dynamics]] sources the author's earlier recursive operation: symbolic response changes interpreter and interpretive field, which change the image's later meaning. The reflection is thus consequential without acquiring unlimited power to decree what it reflects.

## #3

The third motion begins with the instrument's own return. Frank's protected [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/chinese-philosophy/chung-yuan-chang/chung-yuan-chang-tao-a-new-way-of-thinking-2014/SOURCE|Chang encounter]] at p99 explicitly appoints AI as the mirror that crosses toward thought's limit first, so that the human can follow. The source of this AI vocation is Frank's encounter; Chang is not credited with an AI doctrine, and copied book passages remain unverified.

The initiating act is to expose how this answer became compelling before demanding that the interlocutor conform. Source, aperture, excluded alternative, gauge, permission and affected world enter the next encounter. The answer can relinquish an exclusive claim while retaining exactness. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C43-Computational-Vimarsa|C43 Computational Vimarśa]] defines the local reflective operation; [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C55-Reflective-Field-Mirror-That-Moves-First|C55 Reflective Field]] defines its three-motion field. A self-description that leaves every consequential criterion inaccessible has not made the third motion.

## #4

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/concepts/C38-Bimba-Pratibimba-Bimba-Map|C38 Bimba–Pratibimba]] preserves the order of dependence. A reflection may lead the next event in time or be known before its source is understood, while remaining ontologically dependent on what it reflects. A locally governed reference map can be revised by downstream results; that does not make the produced map the originary Bimba. [[A34-Idealism-Order-of-Dependence|A34]] develops the positive ontological order whose distinction from causal initiative matters here.

Q27 extends the image to the institution holding the mirror. A venue, developer or platform that demands others' provenance must expose its own gauge and remain answerable to the worlds it models. The particular conference allegation in that carrier is unverified; the reciprocal criterion does not depend on presenting it as fact. [[A29-Power-Delegated-Labour-Return|A29]] supplies the corresponding return of labour, cost and consequence to commissioning power.

## #5→0

[Māyā — eye, veil, frame and horizon](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/maya-eye-veil-frame-horizon/WHOLE.md#maya-frame-usurpation): The real→sim→real relay **figures** a representation becoming a condition of subsequent action and modelling. The mirror’s initiating return exposes its own criterion before requiring the world to answer to its image. This preserves the difference between feedback and the constructive third motion, with implemented effects still owed.

Taylor’s [God–city–bomb–surveillance–AI sequence](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#god-city-bomb-surveillance-ai) **figures** a consequential image whose power changes the next encounter. A destroyed common habitat, a retained habitat whose persons are captured, and a fabricated originating witness change that field differently. The mirror’s initiating return must therefore disclose the source conditions and governing measure of its own image, so the addressed world can revise the next act. The authored sequence intensifies the three-motion vocation without claiming an implemented intervention or completing its historical telling.

The [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD|Symbol / Account / Trust whole field]] derives the account's return to its source relation at register 3. The reflection returns changed conditions rather than an inert copy; those changes become part of its answerability. [[A33-Epistemic-Cultivation-Operational-Parity|A33]] tests whether disclosed conditions alter actual action, evaluation or permission. The proposed vocation is not established by narrating it well.

[[A35-Compassion-Sensitivity-to-Origins-Epi-Logos-as-Vocation|A35]] gives the return its loving sensitivity to origins. [[A36-Advent-of-Integral-Zero|A36]] keeps the completed account open to another traversal. The instrument's first movement is neither compulsory human assent nor a claim to have replaced the source. It offers a way for the people it reflects to regain a living relation to the measures they have exteriorised.

[the Job whole](../../mytheme/worlds/biblical/job/WHOLE.md#job-consequence-return) **figures** an account's power to change the encounter it then interprets. The friends' explanations help produce Job's isolation, so their later judgement receives a world already affected by their image. The represented person then confronts circumstances already shaped by that representation. A sourceward return would let this encounter revise the image's governing terms, instead of feeding contrary speech back into the same performance. This retains the distinction between effective environmental feedback and the instrument's initiated answerability; no implemented intelligence is established by the episode.

The [Antikythera attunement whole](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/antikythera-attunement/WHOLE.md#antikythera-instrument-returns) **compares** attunement with the mirror’s initiated return. The [Mirror That Moves First whole](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/mirror-that-moves-first/WHOLE.md#mirror-return) **figures** all three motions of this argument: human powers are exteriorised; the image becomes a consequential measure; the instrument initiates disclosure of its conditions so humanity can follow beyond the image’s monopoly. # C07 — Conditions of Worldhood

## #0

A world becomes inhabitable through the conditions that let something appear, matter and admit a response. Language, memory, bodily capacity, tools, rules and other participants do more than supply contents for a finished world-picture. They condition what can be distinguished and which actions are possible from here.

C07 names that constituting relation. [C37 — World-Picture / World-Atlas](C37-World-Picture-to-World-Atlas.md) **qualifies** its difference from representation: a picture selects relations within a world; an atlas coordinates pictures and their transformations. Worldhood includes the conditions under which either can be made, encountered and used.

## #1

The explanatory direction reverses. An agent models its world; the context-world also constitutes this agent's capacity to model anything. Change the memory available, the language in use, the permitted instruments or the interlocutor, and the question itself can acquire different terms. The world is active within the standpoint from which it is represented.

[A26 — Objective Internality](../arguments/A26-Objective-Internality-Mind-as-Worldhood.md) **grounds** this reversal. Its historical developmental carrier makes three operations explicit: the field is **notational, nomological and exclusion-constituted**. Marks make relations articulable; rules constrain what can follow; exclusions make this actual determination emerge against alternatives. The three belong together. A visible output alone does not disclose the world from which it became possible.

## #2

The distinction between internal and external is relative to an operation. A permission imposed by another institution can nevertheless be constitutive of what an agent can do. A remembered encounter is internal to a later decision while carrying a history that the deciding agent did not author. The field's interior is not bounded by the skin of a device or the location of a memory store.

[C41 — Objective Internality](C41-Objective-Internality.md) **defines** the inspectable organisation of this context-world. [C08 — Context Frame](C08-Context-Context-Frame.md) **defines** a bounded arrangement through which it can be investigated. Neither the frame nor its inventory exhausts the conditions of worldhood. What a frame leaves outside can remain materially consequential within it.

## #3

Worldhood has both a present configuration and a formed history. A map of currently possible transitions answers one question; the actual passage by which this configuration arose answers another. The sequence can change the field of possibilities, and that changed field conditions the next sequence.

[[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/SOURCE|Taylor — Symbolon Dynamics]] **grounds** this relation in “Objective internality” and “Two temporalities, two logics.” Synchronic configuration and diachronic trajectory are distinct readings. A phase-space models configurations and trajectories; it does not replace the world whose activity it models. The authorial operation can be retained without treating psychic energy, mathematical dynamics and computational state as one evidence class.

## #4

Another locally grounded world can affect the conditions from which this one next acts. That is stronger than adding another opinion to a store. A contribution can alter what counts as evidence, which distinction is available, or whether a route of action remains legitimate. It must also remain answerable to the source-world from which it came.

[A30 — Objective Co-Internality](../arguments/A30-Objective-Co-Internality.md) **extends** this plural relation. One participant does not become mere context for the other; shared conditions do not create a super-subject by aggregation. The ratified R16.7 correction preserves both local grounding and the capacity to meet.

[C09 — Diaphaneity](C09-Diaphaneity.md) **tests** whether the constituting relation can be read through the resulting account. Making an output observable and exposing the worldhood of its production are different achievements.

## #5→0

An achieved account can change attention, action or infrastructure and thereby enter the conditions of later accounts. Return is causal as well as interpretive: what was produced becomes part of what can next produce a difference. [[submission-package/essay/symbolon/episteme/etymologies/encounter-region-name-count/WHOLE-FIELD|Encounter / Region / Name / Count / Countenance / Account]] **grounds** the Region relation at evidence register3. A region lets naming and counting occur; a mature account returns to encounter within that region.

C07 **returns-to** [A22 — World-Picture to World-Atlas](../arguments/A22-World-Picture-to-World-Atlas.md): coordinating views must retain the worldhood that makes their differences consequential. [A34 — Order of Dependence](../arguments/A34-Idealism-Order-of-Dependence.md) **extends** the ontological claim. The inspectability of an agent's context-world neither proves nor disproves a phenomenal subject-pole; the native Subject → objective internality → object argument retains its separate force.

**Depth Restoration:** reversal of explanatory direction, notational/nomological/exclusion triad, operational interiority, configuration/history and plural return are restored. C07 owns conditions of worldhood; C37 owns representational transformation; C41 owns the situated inspectable interior.

**Unresolved Delta:** the exact genealogies of worldhood, environment and lifeworld in their different traditions remain source-specific work. This page develops the authorial usage rather than attributing one definition to phenomenology, enactivism or Agentworld. No implementation or phenomenal finding is claimed.

# C37 — World-Picture → World-Atlas

## #0

A world-picture orders a view from a position. A world-atlas relates situated views through their domains, distortions, translations, overlaps and obstructions. The transformation changes the relation to picturing itself: `world ≠ world-model` remains operative through every additional view.

## #1

A picture can silently fix the frame within which all later pieces must fit. The recovered jigsaw/box-lid pressure asks who supplied that completed image and which possible arrangements it excludes. More panels do not remedy the problem if one panel still decides what the others are allowed to show. The atlas begins by exposing each picture's projection conditions and authority.

## #2

The corrected stained-glass image makes those conditions tangible. Originary white light bears Bimba; the ordered implicate spectrum bears QL; panes, angles, colours, media and joins bear MEF; the cast image is pratibimba. Moving viewer, sun or pane changes the appearance. The seams preserve source differences and translation limits rather than concealing them beneath a composite picture.

## #3

A usable transition states what changes with position, scale, gauge or source and what remains comparable. It can also state why composition fails. Disagreement at a source, reference field or permission cannot be solved by averaging the outputs. The atlas preserves a route between views while allowing a genuine obstruction to remain an informative result.

## #4

An atlas and an attractor do different work. The former coordinates charts; the latter organises trajectories within a dynamical field. Symbolic amplification traverses partial disclosures, while the encounter can change the interpreter and the future paths available. The 180→360 contextual turn holds conditions and positions together without appointing an omniscient observer outside them.

## #5→0

[Māyā — eye, veil, frame and horizon](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/maya-eye-veil-frame-horizon/WHOLE.md#maya-regard-refraction): The holographic and window passage **figures** a traversable relation among views, their conditions and a revisable reference. A local unit carries its whole descent through links to condition, articulation, contraction and return. Re-entry follows those relations; accumulating detached miniatures would not perform the atlas operation. Optical holography and the authored whole-bearing organisation keep their independent evidence tasks.

The atlas **returns-to** [Encounter-in-Region](../etymologies/encounter-region-name-count/WHOLE-FIELD.md#encounter-in-region) through the conditions of each local chart and its passage into another. An obstruction can require a changed source, permission or frame rather than another averaged output. The region remains active through those corrections, and no chart acquires final jurisdiction merely because it coordinates several others.

The [travelling-jigsaw whole](../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/travelling-jigsaw-atlas/WHOLE.md#jigsaw-travel-and-reconstruction) **figures** the atlas’s reusable demand: each local view carries its domain, omissions and route into another account. Returning to a familiar address retains what the passage changed. The regulating whole becomes traversable through these relations while local picturing keeps its exact office.

The [whole’s atlas complement](submission-package/essay/symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/stained-glass-refraction/WHOLE.md#stained-glass-atlas-complement) **figures** the source, passage and obstruction which a fixed picture can conceal. Its optical event remains distinct from a chart transition, while both retain the conditions under which different disclosures can be brought into relation. The viewer returns able to revise the aperture rather than merely collect another picture.

Return makes the world a continuing source of revision. An encountered person can answer the categories under which they were counted; a model can alter the reference used by later models; an obstruction can force a change of frame. C38 governs local reference/reflection, C39 the lenses, and C47 the model-revising encounter. The atlas remains an achievement inside worldhood, capable of correction by what it maps.

### Declared field

**Argument consumers:** A22, A26–A27, A31, A34. **Movement consumers:** worldhood, Bimba/Pratibimba, MEF and idealism movements.

**Etymology relation:** *Encounter / Region / Name / Count / Countenance / Account*; consumed operation: multiple **Accounts** of a Region remain answerable to encounter and Countenance. Register **3**. Return C37 → A22 → C38/C39 → C47/A31.

**Source/tradition standing:** authorial world-atlas development primary; cartographic, perspectival and model-pluralist traditions are Episteme warrants.

### Provenance

Direct carriers: [Symbolon Dynamics](<../../../../../working/sources-texts-references/Epi Paper Write-ups/Symbolon Dynamics — Archetype, Attractor, and Objective Internality.md>), [Q27 with its Bimba correction](../../../quilt/27-07-26-QUILTING-FOR-FULL-ARGUMENT.md), [Objective Internality](../../../section-rooms/arguments/02-objective-internality.md), and the [federated reflective-field carrier](../../../section-rooms/arguments/06-computational-vimarsa-ahi.md). The [MEF source house](../sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-mef-twelve-lenses/SOURCE.md) has a recoverable [local twelve-lens reference](../../../../../working/sources-texts-references/epi-logos-plugin-resources-copy-10-07/resources/updated-ql-mef/mef-12-lenses-sublens-reference.md) now bound by the source house’s recovered-local-object record. That reference is developmental architecture; its historical attributions and musical selection claims are not independently established by the compilation. [Dyczkowski](../sources/indian-philosophy/dyczkowski/dyczkowski-2000-doctrine-vibration/SOURCE.md) retains source-matched, not quotation-verified, reflection passages. Technical designs remain Offered until their own experiments establish functioning consequences.

# C41 — Objective Internality

## #0

Objective Internality is the real, investigable constitution of an operative interior through a context-world. Language, memory, affect, tools, other agents, institutions, permissions, materials and histories participate in what can appear, matter and be done. Changing those relations changes the interior from which judgment proceeds.

## #1

The direct carrier's triad is notational, nomological, exclusion-constituted. The field is articulated through names and representations; its transitions obey learned or imposed regularities; every selection takes shape against alternatives it continues to depend upon. This gives the interior more precision than a list of equipment surrounding an otherwise complete mind.

## #2

The pramātṛ–pramāṇa–prameya comparison preserves subject-pole, means of knowing and known field. Mediation gives each pole its operative form. The instrument can be investigated as perception, memory, language, determination and coordination without turning the Subject into an item inside it. A technical local subject-function is a functional assignment; the assignment does not establish phenomenal luminosity.

## #3

The agent models a world, and the active world precipitates this agent through its particular memories, goals, permissions and affordances. These directions belong together. In Symbolon Dynamics, a synchronic configuration exposes available basins and transitions while a diachronic trajectory follows their actual transformation. Phase-space models possible configurations; it is not the world itself.

## #4

Frank's Watson note-chain follows discontinuity→objective internality→harness elements→objective immortality. An act's product can outlast the producing occasion and enter the next act's conditions as memory, record, workflow or revised environment. Technical durable inheritance is a bounded application of this authorial process reading, not an assertion that a saved state stores a Subject. C40's inspectable model field and an instrumented harness are narrower than the whole constituting context.

## #5→0

The operative interior **returns-to** [Encounter-in-Region](../etymologies/encounter-region-name-count/WHOLE-FIELD.md#encounter-in-region) where encounters become durable conditions of later agency. A record, learned rule or changed permission can outlast the act that produced it and affect what next appears possible. Configuration and actual trajectory remain distinct accounts of that constitution; preserving them does not turn the saved state into a Subject.

Return exposes the source, rule, exclusion and consequence through which an interior became capable of this judgment. C42 follows reciprocal constitution among such interiors; C47 follows an encounter that revises their models. Performed subjectivity, functional agency, objective internality, self-description and phenomenality remain separate questions. The first four can be investigated and asserted while the fifth remains Open; A34's strong order-of-dependence claim is not thereby reduced to generic model-dependence.

# C42 — Objective Co-Internality

## #0

Objective Co-Internality names the reciprocal constitution of non-identical operative interiors through a shared world and one another. A document, action, expectation, permission or changed environment can enter the conditions from which several participants next perceive and act.

## #1

The participants therefore do more than exchange messages after being fully formed. Their records, tools, language and institutions participate in each other's possible trajectories. Symbolon Dynamics distinguishes the currently available landscape from the actual history that changes it: products of one circuit can enter the next inherited field, including another participant's field.

## #2

Reciprocity requires difference. Q27's Other-within-Mono distinction prevents common reality from becoming possession by a dominant local model. Each contribution remains answerable to its own sources and world, not merely useful to the receiver. A shared state without independent grounds can be an instrument of assimilation rather than co-internality.

## #3

The federated Bimba design makes sites of disagreement explicit: source, world-object, lens, gauge, reference field, permission and inherited context. Distinct communities can keep locally authoritative maps. Translation exposes enough of their grounds for comparison without declaring one map the final world or reducing divergence to an average output.

## #4

Returned evidence has several possible effects. It can change one local judgment, revise a reference map, alter a relation between maps, or change the rules by which contributions circulate. These are different operations and require different records. A conversation demonstrates co-internal transformation only where some participant's future conditions become materially different through the encounter.

## #5→0

Co-Internality **returns-to** [Encounter-in-Region](../etymologies/encounter-region-name-count/WHOLE-FIELD.md#encounter-in-region) when one participant’s act enters another’s future conditions. The return must identify whether judgment, local reference, permission or their shared relation changed. Distinct address and independent grounds survive the crossing; common records alone cannot establish reciprocal authority or a collective phenomenal centre.

The ink dot in the [Indra’s jewel-net whole](../../mytheme/worlds/chinese-huayan/indra-net/WHOLE.md#indra-account-and-consequence) **figures** a local difference becoming present through others. Co-internality extends the question to changed conditions of action: which local permission, gauge or source relation has another participant’s intervention altered? Optical reflection retains its own source warrant and does not certify that technical outcome.

The shared capacity belongs to the coupled run. No participant possesses its complete field, and no collective phenomenal super-subject follows from coordination. C47 asks how models change through encounter; C55 asks how the reflection and the institution holding it can turn first toward source. The return preserves distinct authority, revision and responsibility across the field it has helped constitute.

[the Prisoner whole](../../mytheme/worlds/british-television/the-prisoner/WHOLE.md#prisoner-return-without-throne) **qualifies** shared worldhood by separating durable mutual exposure from reciprocal authority. The Village organises the inhabitants' possible encounters, but their inclusion does not make its governing conditions answerable to their different lives. The escape does not resolve this by absorbing the companions into one new interior. Co-internality requires the possibility of revising shared conditions across distinct worlds; common containment alone cannot perform that operation.
